symptom: `describe microflow OIDC.GetLoginEndpoint` (Evora) carries MDL-FLOW01 'NOT equivalent … must not be re-executed' and is indeed wrong: an arm two decisions deep that should go to the shared 'build authorization URL' region falls out of the `if` and lands on the nonce cookie instead
cause: Interleaved overlaps (more than one entry) were deliberately never labelled ('the describer cannot build branch structure from two entries'), so arms reaching a shared region at different depths were nested as fall-through
file: `mdl/executor/cmd_microflows_show_crossed.go` (interleavedIfEntries), `cmd_microflows_show_helpers.go` (armFallsInto gates the post-`end if` join), `cmd_microflows_show_crossed_test.go` (IgnoresInterleaved → two tests)
insight: For an `if` (not a case/type split) whose interleaved entries are ALL merges, labelling every entry and the join is enough: each arm joins, each region is a section that joins the next. One more piece was needed — when no arm falls out of the `if` (all return or join), the crossed join must not be written after `end if`, or the builder invents an edge out of nothing; the textbook A→{B,C}, B/C→{D,E} fixture caught it. Measured on Evora: fixes GetLoginEndpoint, retires a stale MDL-FLOW01 on 6 more flows that already rebuilt correctly (AgentCommons ×5, ConversationalUI.TraceFiltering_CreateFilterLabels), 0 new invariant violations. An interleaved overlap entered at an activity still keeps MDL-FLOW01. Guards `TestDescribeInterleavedIf_*`, `TestLabelCrossedMerges_*Interleaved*`, repro `mdl-examples/bug-tests/describe-irreducible-interleaved-if.mdl`
